placement: Core (kernel mechanism + contract, protocol 1.3 additive) — the representation of a response, which response headers are returned, the credentials mode and a same-origin XSRF cookie-to-header binding are properties of the one fetch call the Http effect already makes; no pack could supply them without a second, competing Http path. All are optional request fields with the current behaviour as the default, so the JSON path is unchanged and a 1.2 engine never sees a new field. Retry, caching, auth policy and polling stay out of the kernel (engine library, separate item); progress and binary uploads are an optional profile pack (separate item).
